lessons.culture: 張湛, the 4th-century editor of the *Liezi*, adds a comment at the end of the story: people who want results by evening sigh at the end of the year, but the great man takes heaven and earth for a single morning and countless generations for one long breath, and does not mind whether the work is finished by himself or by others. Mao's reading in 1945 was the same in a political key: the work is collective and goes on beyond any one life. Today 愚公移山 is the standard idiom for tireless perseverance against impossible odds.

tracks.about: The written language beyond HSK 5 (the 2012 level, 2,500 words): public-domain essays and fiction, read for the literary words that textbooks stop before.

lessons.title: 落花生

source.author: 許地山 (1894–1941)
source.text_from: 《許地山作品選集》(好讀出版), as excerpted by 遠見 gvm.com.tw/article/60672; compared line by line on 2026-11-12

lessons.intro: Xu Dishan was born in Tainan in 1894; his family left Taiwan for Fujian after the Japanese takeover the next year. He became a scholar of religion, ended his career as professor of Chinese at the University of Hong Kong, and signed his fiction 落華生, "Peanut". This essay was published in 1922 and has been in Chinese school readers ever since. The sentences are short and the story is a family evening, which makes it a good first step: nearly every word you don't know here is a *written* word, the layer of vocabulary that starts where the HSK 5 stopped. Watch the five words built on 然.

lines.en: Behind our house there was half a mu of unused ground.

lines.h: 母親說：「讓它荒蕪著怪可惜，既然你們那麼愛吃花生，就闢來做花生園罷。」
lines.en: Mother said, "It's rather a shame to leave it lying waste. Since you're all so fond of peanuts, let's clear it and make a peanut garden."
lines.h_s: 母亲说：「让它荒芜著怪可惜，既然你们那么爱吃花生，就辟来做花生园罢。」

lines.h: 我們幾姊弟和幾個小丫頭都很喜歡——買種的買種，動土的動土，灌園的灌園；
lines.en: We children and the few young maids were all delighted. Some bought seed, some dug the ground, some watered the plot;
lines.h_s: 我们几姊弟和几个小丫头都很喜欢——买种的买种，动土的动土，灌园的灌园；

lines.h: 過不了幾個月，居然收穫了！
lines.en: and before many months had gone by, to our surprise, there was a harvest!
lines.h_s: 过不了几个月，居然收获了！

lines.h: 媽媽說：「今晚我們可以做一個收穫節，也請你們爹爹來嘗嘗我們的新花生，如何？」
lines.en: Mama said, "Tonight we could hold a harvest festival, and ask your father to come and taste our new peanuts. What do you say?"
lines.h_s: 妈妈说：「今晚我们可以做一个收获节，也请你们爹爹来尝尝我们的新花生，如何？」

lines.en: We all agreed.

lines.h: 母親把花生做成好幾樣的食品，還吩咐這節期要在園裡的茅亭舉行。
lines.en: Mother made the peanuts into a good many dishes, and gave word that the festival was to be held in the thatched pavilion in the garden.
lines.h_s: 母亲把花生做成好几样的食品，还吩咐这节期要在园里的茅亭举行。

lines.h: 那晚上的天色不大好，可是爹爹也到來，實在很難得！
lines.en: The sky was not very promising that evening, but Father came all the same, which was a rare thing indeed!
lines.h_s: 那晚上的天色不大好，可是爹爹也到来，实在很难得！

lines.h: 爹爹說：「你們愛吃花生麼？」
lines.en: Father said, "Do you like eating peanuts?"
lines.h_s: 爹爹说：「你们爱吃花生么？」

lines.en: We all raced to answer, "We do!"
"Who can tell me what is good about the peanut?"

lines.h: 姊姊說：「花生的氣味很美。」
lines.en: Elder sister said, "Peanuts have a lovely flavour."
lines.h_s: 姊姊说：「花生的气味很美。」

lines.en: Elder brother said, "You can make oil from peanuts."

lines.h: 我說：「無論何等人都可以用賤價買它來吃；都喜歡吃它。這就是它的好處。」
lines.en: I said, "People of every sort can buy them cheaply to eat, and everyone likes them. That is what's good about them."
lines.h_s: 我说：「无论何等人都可以用贱价买它来吃；都喜欢吃它。这就是它的好处。」

lines.h: 爹爹說：「花生的用處固然很多，但有一樣是很可貴的。
lines.en: Father said, "The peanut has many uses, to be sure, but one thing about it is truly precious.
lines.h_s: 爹爹说：「花生的用处固然很多，但有一样是很可贵的。

lines.h: 這小小的豆不像那好看的蘋果、桃子、石榴，把它們的果實懸在枝上，
lines.en: This little bean is not like the handsome apple, peach and pomegranate, which hang their fruit on the branch,
lines.h_s: 这小小的豆不像那好看的苹果、桃子、石榴，把它们的果实悬在枝上，

lines.h: 鮮紅嫩綠的顏色，令人一望而發生羨慕的心。
lines.en: bright red and tender green, so that one look is enough to make people admire them.
lines.lit: causing people, at one glance, to have an admiring heart arise
lines.h_s: 鲜红嫩绿的颜色，令人一望而发生羡慕的心。

lines.h: 它只把果子埋在地下，等到成熟，才容人把它挖出來。
lines.en: It just buries its fruit in the ground, and only when it is ripe does it let anyone dig it up.
lines.h_s: 它只把果子埋在地下，等到成熟，才容人把它挖出来。

lines.h: 你們偶然看見一棵花生瑟縮地長在地上，不能立刻辨出它有沒有果實，
lines.en: If you happen to see a peanut plant huddled low on the ground, you can't tell straight away whether it has any fruit;
lines.h_s: 你们偶然看见一棵花生瑟缩地长在地上，不能立刻辨出它有没有果实，

lines.h: 必得等到你接觸它才能知道。」
lines.en: you have to wait until you touch it to know."
lines.h_s: 必得等到你接触它才能知道。」

lines.h: 我們都說：「是的。」母親也點點頭。
lines.en: We all said, "That's true." Mother nodded too.
lines.h_s: 我们都说：「是的。」母亲也点点头。

lines.h: 爹爹接下去說：「所以你們要像花生，因為它是有用的，不是偉大、好看的東西。」
lines.en: Father went on, "So you must be like the peanut, because it is a useful thing, not a grand or good-looking one."
lines.h_s: 爹爹接下去说：「所以你们要像花生，因为它是有用的，不是伟大、好看的东西。」

lines.h: 我說：「那麼，人要做有用的人，不要做偉大、體面的人了。」
lines.en: I said, "Then a person should be a useful person, and not a great or grand-looking one."
lines.h_s: 我说：「那么，人要做有用的人，不要做伟大、体面的人了。」

lines.h: 爹爹說：「這是我對於你們的希望。」
lines.en: Father said, "That is what I hope for you."
lines.h_s: 爹爹说：「这是我对于你们的希望。」

lines.en: We talked until the night was nearly over before we parted.

lines.h: 所有花生食品雖然沒有了，然而父親的話現在還印在我心版上。
lines.en: All the peanut dishes are long gone, yet Father's words are printed on my heart to this day.
lines.h_s: 所有花生食品虽然没有了，然而父亲的话现在还印在我心版上。

notes.text: **隙** xì is a crack or gap (空隙, 縫隙), so 隙地 is the bit of land left over between things: a spare plot. In speech you would say 空地. This is the pattern of the whole lesson: a one-character classical word (隙) living on inside a two-character written one.

**怪** as an adverb, "rather, quite", is colloquial northern usage, normally 怪…的 (怪可惜的). **可惜** is 可 + verb, "worth regretting": the same 可 as in 可貴 "worth prizing" (line 15), 可愛, 可怕, 可笑. In Classical Chinese this 可 is still a free word with a passive sense (→ 文言 L1 n.8).

**既然 … 就 …** "since (it is already the case that) …, then …". 既 jì is classical for "already, having done". The 然 is the first of five in this text: 既然, 居然, 固然, 雖然, 然而. Classical 然 means "so, like that"; stuck onto a word it makes "in such a way" (→ 文言 L3 n.3), and that is how the written language builds its adverbs and conjunctions.

**闢** pì "to open up, clear (land)", as in 開闢. Careful with the simplified form: 辟 stands for two different words, 闢 pì "open up" and 辟 bì "sovereign; to ward off" (復辟 fùbì "restoration of a monarch").
**罷** here is the particle *ba*, today written 吧. Writers of the 1920s wrote 罷 for it, and 麼 for 嗎 (line 9: 愛吃花生麼？). Both are read as the modern particles. As a full word 罷 is bà "to stop" (罷工, 罷了).

**A 的 A, B 的 B** "some did A, some did B": each 的 phrase is "the ones who …". 種 is zhǒng "seed" here, not zhòng "to plant". 動土 "break ground" and 灌園 "water the garden" are verb + object in the classical way, one character each.
**居然** "unexpectedly, against what one would think". The children are amazed their own work produced anything. Its near-twin 竟然 is a little stronger and can be used for bad surprises.

In the first printing (《小說月報》, 1922) this was 我們**底**新花生, and the last line 父親**底**話. For some years in the 1920s many writers kept 的 for descriptions (好看的蘋果) and wrote 底 for possession. Later editions, like ours, print 的 throughout; in an old edition of 魯迅 or 許地山 you will meet 底 on every page.
**如何** at the end of a proposal: "how about it?". It is the classical question 何如 / 如何, "what is it like?" (→ 文言 L6 n.3), and still the normal written word for 怎麼樣.

**吩咐** fēnfù "to give instructions" (to children, servants, juniors). 節期 "the time of a festival" is rare; the "harvest festival" is the mother's own invention. 茅亭 is a pavilion roofed with 茅 máo, thatch grass.

**何等** "what kind, what rank of": 何 is the classical "what". Today 何等 is mostly an exclamation, "how very" (何等重要!). **賤價** "low price": 賤 keeps its oldest sense, "cheap", the opposite of 貴; in today's speech it is mostly an insult.
**固然 …, 但 …** "admittedly …, but …": the speaker grants a point before making his own. 固 is classical "certainly, by nature" (→ 文言 L5 n.10: 蛇固無足).

notes.at: 令人一望而發生羨慕的心
notes.text: Three written features in one clause. **令** "to cause, make" is the written word for 讓 / 叫 (令人感動). **一 … 而 …** "at a single …, then …": 而 joins two verbs exactly as in Classical Chinese (→ 文言 L1 n.4). And **發生** means "to arise, come into being"; today it is nearly always "to happen". 羨慕的心 is the classical 羨慕之心 with 的 for 之.
notes.at_s: 令人一望而发生羡慕的心

notes.text: **容** "to allow, permit", as in 不容 "does not allow", 容許, 容忍. 才容人 "only then does it let people …".

**瑟縮** sèsuō "huddled, shrinking (as if from cold)". Both syllables begin with s-: it is an alliterative two-syllable word of the classical type, where the sound carries the picture and the characters cannot be translated one by one (compare 彷彿, 徘徊, 參差).
**必得** bìděi "must, have no choice but to". 得 is děi "must", not dé "to get".
**於** yú is the all-purpose classical preposition, "at, in, to, with regard to" (→ 文言 L2 n.5). Written Chinese keeps it inside 對於, 關於, 由於, 至於, 等於, and on its own after a verb: 生於台南 "born in Tainan".
**闌** lán "nearly over, at its end". 夜闌 "deep in the night" is a poetic word; the four-character phrase 夜闌人靜 "the night far gone and everyone quiet" is where you will meet it most.

**雖然 …, 然而 …** "although …, yet …". 然而 is literally "so, and yet": it is the written "but", heavier than 但是 or 可是, and it usually opens the clause that matters most. **心版** is "the printing block of the heart": 版 is a woodblock, which is why the words are 印, printed, on it.

how about it? (written for 怎麼樣)
to give instructions, tell someone to
the look of the sky, the weather
what kind of, of whatever rank
to cause, make (someone feel or do)
to touch, come into contact with
late at night, when the night is nearly over
the 'printing block' of the heart: one's memory

lessons.culture: **The other ending.** The version most people in China know is the primary-school one, which was cut and reworded for children. The text here is the adult original in a modern edition (see note 8 for what the first printing looked like).

tracks.about: 成語 in order of modern frequency, twenty at a time, grouped by pattern.

lessons.title: 對稱
lessons.intro: Many everyday 成語 are built on a frame that repeats: 一X一Y, 無X無Y, 所X所Y, 胡X亂Y. Once you see the frame, you only have to learn the two halves, which usually say the same thing twice (全心全意 "whole heart, whole mind") or repeat a word (日復一日 "day comes back to day"). Learn the frames, not just the words: the same frames make hundreds of rarer 成語.

frames.en: X and Y are near-synonyms; 一 = 'one, the same, every'
whole X, whole Y: total commitment
negation twice: 'without X or Y'
所 + verb = 'what one Xs' (classical nominaliser, → lesson 3)

frames.f: 各X各Y / 隨X隨Y / 何X何Y
frames.en: each…each, wherever…whenever, which…which
frames.f_s: 各X各Y / 随X随Y / 何X何Y

frames.f: 謝X謝Y / 討X還Y / 想X設Y
frames.en: two verb–object pairs side by side
frames.f_s: 谢X谢Y / 讨X还Y / 想X设Y

frames.en: 胡 and 亂 both mean 'wildly, at random'
two adjective–noun or number–noun pairs

ex.h: 这两个双胞胎兄弟长得一模一样。
ex.py: Zhè liǎng gè shuāng bāo tāi xiōng dì zhǎng de yī mó yī yàng.
ex.en: The two twin brothers look exactly alike.
ex.h_t: 這兩個雙胞胎兄弟長得一模一樣。
ex.h_s: 这两个双胞胎兄弟长得一模一样。

ex.h: 醫生繼續觀察病人的一舉一動。
ex.py: Yī shēng jì xù guān chá bìng rén de yī jǔ yī dòng.
ex.en: The doctor kept watching the patient's every move.
ex.h_t: 醫生繼續觀察病人的一舉一動。
ex.h_s: 医生继续观察病人的一举一动。

items.note: Used mostly before a noun with 的 (一年一度的…).

ex.h: 今天，该街道为一年一度的圣帕特里克节游行的主要路径。
ex.py: Jīn tiān, gāi jiē dào wéi yī nián yī dù de Shèng Pàtèlǐkè Jié yóu xíng de zhǔ yào lù jìng.
ex.en: Today the street is the main route of the annual Saint Patrick's Day parade.
ex.h_t: 今天，該街道為一年一度的聖帕特里克節遊行的主要路徑。
ex.h_s: 今天，该街道为一年一度的圣帕特里克节游行的主要路径。

ex.h: 我全心全意地支持你。
ex.py: Wǒ quán xīn quán yì de zhī chí nǐ.
ex.en: I support you wholeheartedly.
ex.h_t: 我全心全意地支持你。
ex.h_s: 我全心全意地支持你。

items.en: without realising it, before you know it

ex.h: 不知不覺，秋天已經到了。
ex.py: Bù zhī bù jué, qiū tiān yǐ jīng dào le.
ex.en: Before we knew it, autumn had come.
ex.h_t: 不知不覺，秋天已經到了。
ex.h_s: 不知不觉，秋天已经到了。

items.note: 天 here is "Heaven" as the moral order, not the sky.

ex.h: 政府官员恳求华盛顿能够协助他们制止这种无法无天的行为。
ex.py: Zhèng fǔ guān yuán kěn qiú Huáshèngdùn néng gòu xié zhù tā men zhì zhǐ zhè zhǒng wú fǎ wú tiān de xíng wéi.
ex.en: Officials begged Washington to help them stop this lawless behaviour.
ex.h_t: 政府官員懇求華盛頓能夠協助他們制止這種無法無天的行為。
ex.h_s: 政府官员恳求华盛顿能够协助他们制止这种无法无天的行为。

ex.h: 他看见人无缘无故被铐进枷锁、被打、被囚禁在地牢。
ex.py: Tā kàn jiàn rén wú yuán wú gù bèi kào jìn jiā suǒ, bèi dǎ, bèi qiú jìn zài dì láo.
ex.en: He saw people put in chains, beaten and locked in dungeons for no reason at all.
ex.h_t: 他看見人無緣無故被銬進枷鎖、被打、被囚禁在地牢。
ex.h_s: 他看见人无缘无故被铐进枷锁、被打、被囚禁在地牢。

items.en: everything someone has done, someone's conduct
items.note: Usually critical. 作 and 為 both mean "do".

ex.h: 汤姆不知道他的所作所为违反了规则。
ex.py: Tāngmǔ bù zhī dào tā de suǒ zuò suǒ wéi wéi fǎn le guī zé.
ex.en: Tom didn't know that what he had done broke the rules.
ex.h_t: 湯姆不知道他的所作所為違反了規則。
ex.h_s: 汤姆不知道他的所作所为违反了规则。

ex.h: 各式各樣的人住在東京。
ex.py: Gè shì gè yàng de rén zhù zài Dōngjīng.

ex.h: …场面实在不好形容，但谢天谢地，我的歌词保住了！
ex.py: … Chǎng miàn shí zài bù hǎo xíng róng, dàn xiè tiān xiè dì, wǒ de gē cí bǎo zhù le!
ex.en: The scene is hard to describe, but thank goodness, my lyrics survived!
ex.h_t: …場面實在不好形容，但謝天謝地，我的歌詞保住了！
ex.h_s: …场面实在不好形容，但谢天谢地，我的歌词保住了！

ex.h: 特技是繪畫（有趣的画）、随时随地都能睡着、舞蹈。
ex.py: Tè jì shì huì huà (yǒu qù de huà), suí shí suí dì dōu néng shuì zháo, wǔ dǎo.

items.en: which way to go, what to do next
items.note: 何 "what" comes before the verb, as in classical Chinese questions (何去 = 去何).

ex.h: 我失業又沒錢。真不知該何去何從。
ex.py: Wǒ shī yè yòu méi qián. Zhēn bù zhī gāi hé qù hé cóng.
ex.en: I've lost my job and I have no money. I really don't know what to do next.
ex.h_t: 我失業又沒錢。真不知該何去何從。
ex.h_s: 我失业又没钱。真不知该何去何从。

ex.h: 那隻狗日復一日地等待著主人的歸來。
ex.py: Nà zhī gǒu rì fù yī rì de děng dài zhe zhǔ rén de guī lái.
ex.en: Day after day the dog waited for its master to come back.

ex.h_s: 那只狗日复一日地等待著主人的归来。

items.note: 還 is huán "give back" here (a counter-offer), not hái.

ex.h: 我們為這棟房子和他討價還價。

ex.h_s: 我们为这栋房子和他讨价还价。

items.en: to let one's imagination run wild, to worry over nothing

ex.h: 喜欢热闹，擅长在上课时胡思乱想。
ex.py: Xǐ huān rè nào, shàn cháng zài shàng kè shí hú sī luàn xiǎng.
ex.en: Loves a lively crowd; good at daydreaming in class.
ex.h_t: 喜歡熱鬧，擅長在上課時胡思亂想。
ex.h_s: 喜欢热闹，擅长在上课时胡思乱想。

ex.h: 汤姆在胡言乱语。
ex.py: Tāngmǔ zài hú yán luàn yǔ.
ex.en: Tom is talking nonsense.
ex.h_t: 湯姆在胡言亂語。
ex.h_s: 汤姆在胡言乱语。

items.note: 八道 "eight ways" = in every direction. Stronger and more colloquial than 胡言亂語.

ex.h: 她们只是胡说八道。
ex.py: Tā men zhǐ shì hú shuō bā dào.
ex.en: They're just talking rubbish.
ex.h_t: 她們只是胡說八道。
ex.h_s: 她们只是胡说八道。

ex.h: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
ex.py: Tā xiǎng fāng shè fǎ yǐ yī jǐ zhī lì wán chéng le gōng zuò.
ex.en: She found a way to finish the work on her own.
ex.h_t: 她想方設法以一己之力完成了工作。
ex.h_s: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。

origin.text: 何故深思高舉…願君熟慮之

ex.h: 该实验的每一步都是经过深思熟虑的。
ex.py: Gāi shí yàn de měi yī bù dōu shì jīng guò shēn sī shú lǜ de.
ex.en: Every step of the experiment was carefully thought out.
ex.h_t: 該實驗的每一步都是經過深思熟慮的。
ex.h_s: 该实验的每一步都是经过深思熟虑的。

ex.h: 报导说，施莱佛被捕事件，充分表明北京千方百计想渗透中情局。
ex.py: Bào dǎo shuō, Shīláifó bèi bǔ shì jiàn, chōng fèn biǎo míng Běijīng qiān fāng bǎi jì xiǎng shèn tòu Zhōngqíngjú.

lessons.title: 數字
lessons.intro: Numbers in 成語 are almost never real counts. 一 means "the whole, the same, once, at once", 七八 means "all over the place", 千 and 萬 mean "countless", 四面八方 "every direction". Paired numbers (一清二楚, 亂七八糟) give rhythm more than meaning. The last few items of the lesson are about wholes and pieces (從頭到尾, 支離破碎), the same idea without numbers.

frames.en: 'one…two…': completely, thoroughly
'seven…eight…': in a mess, all over
thousands, tens of thousands: countless
not a single X (→ 所, lesson 3)
alone one, no second: unique

ex.h: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。
ex.py: Měi nián yǒu chéng qiān shàng wàn de wài guó rén fǎng wèn Rìběn.
ex.en: Thousands of foreigners visit Japan every year.
ex.h_t: 每年有成千上萬的外國人訪問日本。
ex.h_s: 每年有成千上万的外国人访问日本。

ex.h: 这里的天气有独一无二的特点。
ex.py: Zhè lǐ de tiān qì yǒu dú yī wú èr de tè diǎn.
ex.en: The weather here has some unique features.
ex.h_t: 這裡的天氣有獨一無二的特點。
ex.h_s: 这里的天气有独一无二的特点。

ex.h: 她工作做得亂七八糟。
ex.py: Tā gōng zuò zuò de luàn qī bā zāo.
ex.en: She made a complete mess of her work.
ex.h_t: 她工作做得亂七八糟。
ex.h_s: 她工作做得乱七八糟。

ex.h: 我看见小动物向四面八方跑去。
ex.py: Wǒ kàn jiàn xiǎo dòng wù xiàng sì miàn bā fāng pǎo qù.
ex.en: I saw the little animals run off in all directions.
ex.h_t: 我看見小動物向四面八方跑去。
ex.h_s: 我看见小动物向四面八方跑去。

items.note: Often after 得 or 的 (記得一清二楚 "remember perfectly").

ex.h: 對於搬到這裡的湯瑪斯家的人是好是壞，她都知道的一清二楚。
ex.py: Duì yú bān dào zhè lǐ de Tāngmǎsī jiā de rén shì hǎo shì huài, tā dōu zhī dào de yī qīng èr chǔ.
ex.src: wikipedia: 你好 安妮 ～Before Green Gables
ex.en: She knows perfectly well whether the Thomas family who moved here are good people or bad.
ex.h_t: 對於搬到這裡的湯瑪斯家的人是好是壞，她都知道的一清二楚。
ex.h_s: 对于搬到这里的汤玛斯家的人是好是坏，她都知道的一清二楚。

ex.h: 我一無所有。
ex.py: Wǒ yī wú suǒ yǒu.
ex.en: I have nothing.
ex.h_t: 我一無所有。
ex.h_s: 我一无所有。

items.en: to know nothing at all about something

ex.h: 真奇怪, 你對她的婚禮一無所知。
ex.py: Zhēn qí guài, nǐ duì tā de hūn lǐ yī wú suǒ zhī.
ex.en: It's strange that you know nothing about her wedding.
ex.h_t: 真奇怪, 你對她的婚禮一無所知。
ex.h_s: 真奇怪, 你对她的婚礼一无所知。

ex.h: 某天回家的路上，善也一如既往的在霞關站等候地鐵。
ex.py: Mǒu tiān huí jiā de lù shàng, Shànyě yī rú jì wǎng de zài Xiáguān Zhàn děng hòu dì tiě.
ex.en: One day on his way home, Yoshiya was waiting for the subway at Kasumigaseki station as usual.
ex.h_t: 某天回家的路上，善也一如既往的在霞關站等候地鐵。
ex.h_s: 某天回家的路上，善也一如既往的在霞关站等候地铁。

items.en: a place, a foothold (in a field)
items.note: 席 is the mat people sat on; 之 is the classical "of" (→ lesson 3). Usually 占有一席之地.

ex.h: 依靠如此多方面的成就，他理应在音乐史上占有一席之地。
ex.py: Yī kào rú cǐ duō fāng miàn de chéng jiù, tā lǐ yīng zài yīn yuè shǐ shàng zhàn yǒu yī xí zhī dì.
ex.src: wikipedia: 伊格纳茨·普莱耶尔
ex.en: With so many achievements, he deserves a place in the history of music.
ex.h_t: 依靠如此多方面的成就，他理應在音樂史上佔有一席之地。
ex.h_s: 依靠如此多方面的成就，他理应在音乐史上占有一席之地。

ex.h: 這個路口正在翻修，被挖得一塌糊塗。
ex.py: Zhè ge lù kǒu zhèng zài fān xiū, bèi wā de yī tā hú tú.
ex.en: This crossroads is being rebuilt, and it's been dug up into a complete mess.
ex.h_t: 這個路口正在翻修，被挖得一塌糊塗。
ex.h_s: 这个路口正在翻修，被挖得一塌糊涂。

origin.text: 刑者，侀也。侀者，成也。一成而不可變
origin.text_s: 刑者，侀也。侀者，成也。一成而不可变

items.note: The source is about punishment, which cannot be undone once carried out.

ex.h: 终其一生，他绘画的风格几乎一成不变。
ex.py: Zhōng qí yī shēng, tā huì huà de fēng gé jī hū yī chéng bù biàn.
ex.src: wikipedia: 克洛德·约瑟夫·韦尔内
ex.en: Throughout his life, his painting style hardly changed.
ex.h_t: 終其一生，他繪畫的風格幾乎一成不變。
ex.h_s: 终其一生，他绘画的风格几乎一成不变。

ex.h: 退团後，堀内敬子的演艺生涯并非一帆风顺。
ex.py: Tuì tuán hòu, Kūnèi Jìngzǐ de yǎn yì shēng yá bìng fēi yī fān fēng shùn.
ex.en: After leaving the troupe, Horiuchi Keiko's acting career was not all plain sailing.
ex.h_t: 退團後，堀內敬子的演藝生涯並非一帆風順。
ex.h_s: 退团后，堀内敬子的演艺生涯并非一帆风顺。

ex.h: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。
ex.py: Lǎo shī yīng gāi yī shì tóng rén de duì dài tā men de xué shēng.
ex.en: Teachers should treat all their students equally.
ex.h_t: 老師應該一視同仁地對待他們的學生。
ex.h_s: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。

ex.h: 我有朝一日会成为一名医生。
ex.py: Wǒ yǒu zhāo yī rì huì chéng wéi yī míng yī shēng.
ex.en: Some day I'll be a doctor.
ex.h_t: 我有朝一日會成為一名醫生。
ex.h_s: 我有朝一日会成为一名医生。

items.en: to be taken completely by surprise
items.note: 吃 "suffer, receive", as in 吃虧.

ex.h: 她肯定会大吃一惊的。
ex.py: Tā kěn dìng huì dà chī yī jīng de.
ex.en: She's bound to be amazed.
ex.h_t: 她肯定會大吃一驚的。
ex.h_s: 她肯定会大吃一惊的。

items.en: to lump together, to confuse two things

ex.h: 同情心和愛心絕不可混為一談。
ex.py: Tóng qíng xīn hé ài xīn jué bù kě hùn wéi yī tán.
ex.en: Sympathy and love must never be confused.
ex.h_t: 同情心和愛心絕不可混為一談。
ex.h_s: 同情心和爱心绝不可混为一谈。

origin.text: 香年十四，手無寸刃，直搤虎頸
origin.text_s: 香年十四，手无寸刃，直搤虎颈

items.note: The source has 刃 "blade": a 14-year-old girl seizes a tiger by the neck to save her father.

ex.h: 美军士兵随后开火，无差别的射杀手无寸铁的印第安人。
ex.py: Měi jūn shì bīng suí hòu kāi huǒ, wú chā bié de shè shā shǒu wú cùn tiě de Yìndì'ān rén.
ex.en: American soldiers then opened fire and shot unarmed Native Americans indiscriminately.
ex.h_t: 美軍士兵隨後開火，無差別的射殺手無寸鐵的印第安人。
ex.h_s: 美军士兵随后开火，无差别的射杀手无寸铁的印第安人。

ex.h: 請你把故事從頭到尾給我們說一遍。
ex.py: Qǐng nǐ bǎ gù shì cóng tóu dào wěi gěi wǒ men shuō yī biàn.
ex.en: Please tell us the story from beginning to end.
ex.h_t: 請你把故事從頭到尾給我們說一遍。
ex.h_s: 请你把故事从头到尾给我们说一遍。

ex.h: 月球事件过后，僵尸肆虐，地球变得如同地狱般支离破碎。
ex.py: Yuè qiú shì jiàn guò hòu, jiāng shī sì nüè, dì qiú biàn de rú tóng dì yù bān zhī lí pò suì.
ex.src: wikipedia: 決勝時刻：黑色行動II

ex.h_t: 月球事件過後，殭屍肆虐，地球變得如同地獄般支離破碎。
ex.h_s: 月球事件过后，僵尸肆虐，地球变得如同地狱般支离破碎。

lessons.title: 虛詞
lessons.intro: Modern Chinese keeps a handful of classical function words alive, mostly inside 成語. Learn these five and a large share of 成語 become readable: 所 + verb "what one Vs", 而 "and, and then, yet", 之 "of" (= 的), 以 "by means of, in order to", 於 "at, to, than" (= 在, 對, 比). Two more appear here: 其 "its, his, their" and 諸 "all the, the various". These are the same words the main Wenyan course teaches in its first lessons.

frames.en: 'what one Vs', a noun: 前所未有 'what before has-not-had'
而 links two actions: 'and then' or 'yet'
之 = 的: 'the Y of X'
以 = 'with, by means of, so as to'
於 = 'to, at, for'
其 = 'its, their'; 諸 = 'all the, the various'

lessons.title: 否定
lessons.title_en: Saying no: 不 and 無
lessons.intro: Negation is the most common building block of high-frequency 成語. 不 negates a verb or an adjective ("not"), 無 negates having ("without, there is no"). The negative often comes second or third, with the structure of classical Chinese: 迫不及待 "pressed, not able to wait", 微不足道 "small, not worth mentioning". The lesson ends with three ways of saying "unexpected" (意想不到, 出乎意料, 出人意料), the kind of near-synonym set teachers in China and Taiwan like to drill.

ex.en: When I heard the news, I didn't know what to do.
ex.h_t: 當我聽到這個消息時, 我束手無策。
ex.h_s: 当我听到这个消息时, 我束手无策。

ex.h: 我們的興趣截然不同。
ex.py: Wǒ men de xìng qù jié rán bù tóng.
ex.en: Our interests are completely different.
ex.h_t: 我們的興趣截然不同。
ex.h_s: 我们的兴趣截然不同。

ex.h: 一時失言常常會帶來意想不到的結果。
ex.py: Yī shí shī yán cháng cháng huì dài lái yì xiǎng bù dào de jié guǒ.
ex.en: A slip of the tongue often has unexpected results.
ex.h_t: 一時失言常常會帶來意想不到的結果。
ex.h_s: 一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。

items.note: 乎 = 於 "beyond". Also 出乎意料之外 (redundant but common).

ex.h: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。
ex.py: Ràng wǒ chū hū yì liào de shì, tā jū rán hěn huì chàng gē.
ex.en: What surprised me was that he actually sings very well.
ex.h_t: 讓我出乎意料的是，他居然很會唱歌。
ex.h_s: 让我出乎意料的是，他居然很会唱歌。

ex.h: 岬的饭量出人意料地大，曾经一个人吃掉好几个人份的咖喱。
ex.py: Jiǎ de fàn liàng chū rén yì liào de dà, céng jīng yī gè rén chī diào hǎo jǐ gè rén fèn de gā lí.
ex.en: Misaki eats a surprising amount: she once finished several people's portions of curry on her own.
ex.h_t: 岬的飯量出人意料地大，曾經一個人吃掉好幾個人份的咖喱。
ex.h_s: 岬的饭量出人意料地大，曾经一个人吃掉好几个人份的咖喱。

ex.h: 当我无家可归的时候，我常在那张长椅上睡觉。
ex.py: Dāng wǒ wú jiā kě guī de shí hòu, wǒ cháng zài nà zhāng cháng yǐ shàng shuì jiào.
ex.en: When I was homeless, I often slept on that bench.
ex.h_t: 當我無家可歸的時候，我常在那張長椅上睡覺。
ex.h_s: 当我无家可归的时候，我常在那张长椅上睡觉。

lessons.title: 意象
lessons.intro: These 成語 are pictures. Read them literally first (feet on solid ground, hands tucked in sleeves, hair and bones standing on end, deep roots and firm stalks) and the figurative meaning follows. Many come from classical texts you will meet in the main course: the 詩經, 老子, 左傳, 禮記·大學.

items.en: to seek truth from facts, to be realistic

origin.text: 河間獻王德…修學好古，實事求是
origin.text_s: 河间献王德…修学好古，实事求是

items.note: Originally praise for a prince who collected old books and checked them carefully. Later a Qing scholarly motto, then a political slogan.

ex.h: 说话要实事求是。
ex.py: Shuō huà yào shí shì qiú shì.
ex.en: Stick to the facts when you speak.
ex.h_t: 說話要實事求是。
ex.h_s: 说话要实事求是。

items.note: 翼翼 "reverent, careful" in the 詩經, not "wings". In modern Chinese the meaning narrowed to "cautious".

ex.h: 警察小心翼翼地抬起了箱子。
ex.py: Jǐng chá xiǎo xīn yì yì de tái qǐ le xiāng zi.
ex.en: The police carefully lifted the box.
ex.h_t: 警察小心翼翼地抬起了箱子。
ex.h_s: 警察小心翼翼地抬起了箱子。

ex.h: 環境災害、極端氣候和全球暖化皆與人為活動息息相關。
ex.py: Huán jìng zāi hài, jí duān qì hòu hé quán qiú nuǎn huà jiē yǔ rén wéi huó dòng xī xī xiāng guān.
ex.en: Environmental disasters, extreme weather and global warming are all closely linked to human activity.
ex.h_t: 環境災害、極端氣候和全球暖化皆與人為活動息息相關。
ex.h_s: 环境灾害、极端气候和全球暖化皆与人为活动息息相关。

items.en: to make a fuss about nothing

ex.h: 不过穆里尔认为母亲过于大惊小怪，并表示丈夫的情况不至于无法控制。
ex.py: Bù guò Mùlǐ'ěr rèn wéi mǔ qīn guò yú dà jīng xiǎo guài, bìng biǎo shì zhàng fū de qíng kuàng bù zhì yú wú fǎ kòng zhì.
ex.src: wikipedia: 逮香蕉鱼的最佳日子
ex.en: But Muriel thinks her mother is making too much fuss, and says her husband's condition isn't out of control.
ex.h_t: 不過穆里爾認為母親過於大驚小怪，並表示丈夫的情況不至於無法控制。
ex.h_s: 不过穆里尔认为母亲过于大惊小怪，并表示丈夫的情况不至于无法控制。

items.note: 逍遙 "to roam at ease" is the 莊子 word (逍遙遊), here used ironically for a criminal.

ex.h: 看着“凶手”逍遥法外，铁飞花暗下决心，一定要将其绳之以法。
ex.py: Kàn zhe “xiōng shǒu” xiāo yáo fǎ wài, Tiě Fēihuā àn xià jué xīn, yī dìng yào jiāng qí shéng zhī yǐ fǎ.
ex.en: Watching the 'murderer' go free, Tie Feihua secretly resolved to bring him to justice.
ex.h_t: 看著“兇手”逍遙法外，鐵飛花暗下決心，一定要將其繩之以法。
ex.h_s: 看着“凶手”逍遥法外，铁飞花暗下决心，一定要将其绳之以法。

items.note: The MOE's edition of the source writes 蔕, an old form of 蒂 "stalk of a fruit" (other editions read 柢 "root").

ex.h: 漕運自清初經過了將近二百年，官吏與運丁累積的弊端已根深蒂固。
ex.py: Cáo yùn zì Qīng chū jīng guò le jiāng jìn èr bǎi nián, guān lì yǔ yùn dīng lěi jī de bì duān yǐ gēn shēn dì gù.
ex.en: Nearly two hundred years after the start of the Qing, the abuses of the officials and boatmen of the grain transport had become entrenched.
ex.h_t: 漕運自清初經過了將近二百年，官吏與運丁累積的弊端已根深蒂固。
ex.h_s: 漕运自清初经过了将近二百年，官吏与运丁累积的弊端已根深蒂固。

items.en: to be among the best, at the top of the list
items.note: 前茅 was the banner (or the reed) carried at the head of a Chu army on the march.

ex.h: 而现在这两地的经济总量和人均收入都在中国名列前茅。
ex.py: Ér xiàn zài zhè liǎng dì de jīng jì zǒng liàng hé rén jūn shōu rù dōu zài Zhōngguó míng liè qián máo.
ex.en: Today both places rank among the top in China for total output and income per head.
ex.h_t: 而現在這兩地的經濟總量和人均收入都在中國名列前茅。
ex.h_s: 而现在这两地的经济总量和人均收入都在中国名列前茅。

ex.h: 我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。
ex.py: Wǒ men dōu bù rèn wéi tā shì shì gù de zuì kuí huò shǒu.
ex.en: None of us think he is to blame for the accident.
ex.h_t: 我們都不認為他是事故的罪魁禍首。
ex.h_s: 我们都不认为他是事故的罪魁祸首。

origin.text: 權在將軍，舉足左右，便有輕重
origin.text_s: 权在将军，举足左右，便有轻重

items.note: Dou Rong held the balance between two warring states: one step to the left or right would tip the scales.

ex.h: 油价的变化对机械化农场的生存有着举足轻重的影响。
ex.py: Yóu jià de biàn huà duì jī xiè huà nóng chǎng de shēng cún yǒu zhe jǔ zú qīng zhòng de yǐng xiǎng.
ex.en: Changes in oil prices have a decisive effect on whether mechanised farms survive.
ex.h_t: 油價的變化對機械化農場的生存有著舉足輕重的影響。
ex.h_s: 油价的变化对机械化农场的生存有着举足轻重的影响。

ex.h: 這些問題歸根結底是體制的問題。
ex.py: Zhè xiē wèn tí guī gēn jié dǐ shì tǐ zhì de wèn tí.
ex.en: In the end, these problems are problems of the system.
ex.h_t: 這些問題歸根結底是體制的問題。
ex.h_s: 这些问题归根结底是体制的问题。

ex.h: 臉上總是浮現令人毛骨悚然的笑容，哼著不可思議的手鞠歌。
ex.py: Liǎn shàng zǒng shì fú xiàn lìng rén máo gǔ sǒng rán de xiào róng, hēng zhe bù kě sī yì de shǒu jū gē.
ex.en: A spine-chilling smile is always on her face as she hums a strange ball-game song.
ex.h_t: 臉上總是浮現令人毛骨悚然的笑容，哼著不可思議的手鞠歌。
ex.h_s: 脸上总是浮现令人毛骨悚然的笑容，哼著不可思议的手鞠歌。

origin.text: 光天之下，至于海隅蒼生
origin.text_s: 光天之下，至于海隅苍生

items.note: First "a peaceful age under a bright sky"; now mostly in 光天化日之下 "in broad daylight", about a crime.

ex.h: 他的车子光天化日被偷走了。
ex.py: Tā de chē zi guāng tiān huà rì bèi tōu zǒu le.
ex.en: His car was stolen in broad daylight.
ex.h_t: 他的車子光天化日被偷走了。
ex.h_s: 他的车子光天化日被偷走了。

items.en: to restore order, to set things right
items.note: Said of Confucius writing the 春秋. 反 = 返 "return"; 諸 = 之於.

ex.h: 现在公室的地位低下，却不能拨乱反正，我的罪过大了。
ex.py: Xiàn zài gōng shì de dì wèi dī xià, què bù néng bō luàn fǎn zhèng, wǒ de zuì guò dà le.
ex.en: The ducal house has sunk low and I cannot set things right: great is my guilt.
ex.h_t: 現在公室的地位低下，卻不能撥亂反正，我的罪過大了。
ex.h_s: 现在公室的地位低下，却不能拨乱反正，我的罪过大了。

ex.h: 中央电视台评论则认为日本政府此举乃别有用心。
ex.py: Zhōngyāng Diànshìtái píng lùn zé rèn wéi Rìběn zhèng fǔ cǐ jǔ nǎi bié yǒu yòng xīn.
ex.en: A CCTV commentary held that the Japanese government had ulterior motives.
ex.h_t: 中央電視臺評論則認為日本政府此舉乃別有用心。
ex.h_s: 中央电视台评论则认为日本政府此举乃别有用心。

items.note: Said of Sima Guang (君實), the historian.

ex.h: 我是个脚踏实地的人。
ex.py: Wǒ shì gè jiǎo tà shí dì de rén.
ex.en: I'm a down-to-earth person.
ex.h_t: 我是個腳踏實地的人。
ex.h_s: 我是个脚踏实地的人。

items.en: to stand by and do nothing
items.note: The source writes 褎 for 袖. Han Yu: the master craftsman watches from the side, hands drawn into his sleeves.

ex.h: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。
ex.py: Zhǐ yào hǎo rén xiù shǒu páng guān, è rén jiù huì dé shèng.
ex.en: Evil triumphs when good people stand by and do nothing.
ex.h_t: 只要好人袖手旁觀，惡人就會得勝。
ex.h_s: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

items.en: confident because one is in the right

origin.text: 便提我到閻羅殿前，我也理直氣壯
origin.text_s: 便提我到阎罗殿前，我也理直气壮

items.note: From a Ming vernacular story: the kind of novel you will read in Shujia.

ex.h: 新浪微博上，「立场坚定斗志强」、「党媒姓党，理直气壮」很快成为热门话题。
ex.py: Xīnlàng Wēibó shàng, “lì chǎng jiān dìng dòu zhì qiáng”, “dǎng méi xìng dǎng, lǐ zhí qì zhuàng” hěn kuài chéng wéi rè mén huà tí.
ex.en: On Sina Weibo, 'firm stance, strong will' and 'the Party media belong to the Party, and say so with confidence' quickly became trending topics.
ex.h_t: 新浪微博上，「立場堅定鬥志強」、「黨媒姓黨，理直氣壯」很快成為熱門話題。
ex.h_s: 新浪微博上，「立场坚定斗志强」、「党媒姓党，理直气壮」很快成为热门话题。

ex.h: 这看起来似曾相识。
ex.py: Zhè kàn qǐ lái sì céng xiāng shí.
ex.en: This looks familiar.
ex.h_t: 這看起來似曾相識。
ex.h_s: 这看起来似曾相识。

origin.text: 夫築城郭，立倉庫，因地制宜
origin.text_s: 夫筑城郭，立仓库，因地制宜

ex.h: 這些方法要因地制宜，並且綜合取得最好的結果，…
ex.py: Zhè xiē fāng fǎ yào yīn dì zhì yí, bìng qiě zōng hé qǔ dé zuì hǎo de jié guǒ,…
ex.en: These methods must be adapted to local conditions and combined to get the best results.
ex.h_t: 這些方法要因地制宜，並且綜合取得最好的結果，…
ex.h_s: 这些方法要因地制宜，并且综合取得最好的结果，…

items.note: King Tang's motto engraved on his bath basin: "renew yourself every day".

ex.h: 建国后至今，竹管垅乡的基础建设日新月异。
ex.py: Jiàn guó hòu zhì jīn, Zhúguǎnlǒng Xiāng de jī chǔ jiàn shè rì xīn yuè yì.
ex.en: Since the founding of the PRC, infrastructure in Zhuguanlong has changed beyond recognition.
ex.h_t: 建國後至今，竹管壠鄉的基礎建設日新月異。
ex.h_s: 建国后至今，竹管垅乡的基础建设日新月异。

lessons.title: 對稱與數字
lessons.intro: The frames of lessons 1 and 2 come back, with new members. 一 is again "whole, single, at once": 一針見血 "one needle, and blood shows", 一觸即發 "one touch and it goes off". Two new frames: X然一新 "brand new", and A來B去-type pairs of opposites that cover the whole range (大街小巷 "big streets and small lanes" = everywhere).

frames.f: 接X連Y / 五X六Y / 千X萬Y
frames.en: numbers in pairs: 'one after another', 'all colours', 'countless'
frames.f_s: 接X连Y / 五X六Y / 千X万Y

frames.f: 無X無Y / 不X不Y / 合X合Y
frames.en: the same word twice around two near-synonyms
frames.f_s: 无X无Y / 不X不Y / 合X合Y

frames.en: as in lesson 1: X and Y are near-synonyms
'once…, at once…': a single action with a big result
big and small = all of them; big X special X = very X

ex.h: 可惜在電影上映後接二連三地接獲負評，票房收入亦不理想。
ex.py: Kě xī zài diàn yǐng shàng yìng hòu jiē èr lián sān de jiē huò fù píng, piào fáng shōu rù yì bù lǐ xiǎng.
ex.en: Unfortunately, once the film came out, bad reviews came in one after another, and the box office was disappointing too.
ex.h_t: 可惜在電影上映後接二連三地接獲負評，票房收入亦不理想。
ex.h_s: 可惜在电影上映后接二连三地接获负评，票房收入亦不理想。

ex.h: 我父母在乡村过着无忧无虑的生活。
ex.py: Wǒ fù mǔ zài xiāng cūn guò zhe wú yōu wú lǜ de shēng huó.
ex.en: My parents live a carefree life in the countryside.
ex.h_t: 我父母在鄉村過著無憂無慮的生活。
ex.h_s: 我父母在乡村过着无忧无虑的生活。

items.en: all the time, at every moment
items.note: Logically it should be 無時無刻不… "there is no moment when not…", and careful writers keep the 不. In speech the 不 is often dropped with the same meaning.

ex.h: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。
ex.py: Tāngmǔ hé Mǎlì wú shí wú kè bù zài biàn lùn.
ex.en: Tom and Mary argue all the time.
ex.h_t: 湯姆和瑪麗無時無刻不在辯論。
ex.h_s: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

ex.h: 她一心一意地工作。
ex.py: Tā yī xīn yī yì de gōng zuò.
ex.en: She works single-mindedly.
ex.h_t: 她一心一意地工作。
ex.h_s: 她一心一意地工作。

ex.h: 房子裏放滿了五顏六色的藝術品。
ex.py: Fáng zi lǐ fàng mǎn le wǔ yán liù sè de yì shù pǐn.
ex.en: The house was full of colourful works of art.
ex.h_t: 房子裡放滿了五顏六色的藝術品。
ex.h_s: 房子里放满了五颜六色的艺术品。

items.en: a thousand words, everything one wants to say

ex.h: 歌曲另一個創作主題為「行動勝過言語」，寫出從友情發展為愛情的感覺，亦帶有「Kiss勝過千言萬語」的歌詞。
ex.py: Gē qǔ lìng yī gè chuàng zuò zhǔ tí wéi “xíng dòng shèng guò yán yǔ”, xiě chū cóng yǒu qíng fā zhǎn wéi ài qíng de gǎn jué, yì dài yǒu “Kiss shèng guò qiān yán wàn yǔ” de gē cí.
ex.en: Another theme of the song is 'actions speak louder than words': it describes friendship turning into love, with the line 'a kiss is worth a thousand words'.
ex.h_t: 歌曲另一個創作主題為「行動勝過言語」，寫出從友情發展為愛情的感覺，亦帶有「Kiss勝過千言萬語」的歌詞。
ex.h_s: 歌曲另一个创作主题为「行动胜过言语」，写出从友情发展为爱情的感觉，亦带有「Kiss胜过千言万语」的歌词。

items.en: to take no interest, to ignore completely

ex.h: 黄氏女到太子会拜佛，路上遭雨淋，生了病，丈夫对其不闻不问。
ex.py: Huángshìnǚ dào Tàizǐ Huì bài fó, lù shàng zāo yǔ lín, shēng le bìng, zhàng fū duì qí bù wén bù wèn.
ex.en: Lady Huang went to worship at the temple fair, was caught in the rain and fell ill, and her husband paid her no attention at all.
ex.h_t: 黃氏女到太子會拜佛，路上遭雨淋，生了病，丈夫對其不聞不問。
ex.h_s: 黄氏女到太子会拜佛，路上遭雨淋，生了病，丈夫对其不闻不问。

ex.h: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。
ex.py: Yǒu shí hòu, fā shēng de shì qíng bìng bù shì hé qíng hé lǐ de.
ex.en: Sometimes what happens isn't reasonable.
ex.h_t: 有時候，發生的事情並不是合情合理的。
ex.h_s: 有时候，发生的事情并不是合情合理的。

ex.h: 每年正月十五元宵夜，大龍蜿蜒於鄉間村野，穿行於大街小巷。
ex.py: Měi nián zhēng yuè shí wǔ yuán xiāo yè, dà lóng wān yán yú xiāng jiān cūn yě, chuān xíng yú dà jiē xiǎo xiàng.
ex.en: Every year on the night of the Lantern Festival, a great dragon winds through the villages and fields and all through the streets of the town.
ex.h_t: 每年正月十五元宵夜，大龍蜿蜒於鄉間村野，穿行於大街小巷。
ex.h_s: 每年正月十五元宵夜，大龙蜿蜒于乡间村野，穿行于大街小巷。

items.en: to fool oneself as well as others

origin.text: 其自欺欺人之狀，不窮而自露也
origin.text_s: 其自欺欺人之状，不穷而自露也

ex.h: 威廉姆斯认为，想要超越个人的观点，只能是自欺欺人。

lessons.title: 虛詞（二）
lessons.intro: More 文言 function words, frozen inside modern 成語. 而 again links two verbs ("and, and then, yet"). 之 is now also an object pronoun "it" (持之以恆 "hold it with constancy"). 以 marks the means or the purpose (以身作則 "with one's own person, make a model"). 其 is "its, the" and 可 + verb is "can be V-ed" (屈指可數 "can be counted on the fingers"). 所 + verb, from lesson 3, turns a verb into "what one Vs".

frames.en: 而 joins a manner or a first action to the main verb
之 = 'it', the object
'with, by means of' or 'so as to'
'its, his, the'
'nothing that can be V-ed' / 'can be V-ed'
'what one Vs' / 'the N of'

lessons.title: 心情
lessons.intro: How people feel and react: pleased, delighted, gloating, hesitant, suddenly enlightened, indifferent, worried, exasperated, caught off guard. Several share the 心 "heart, mind" family (心滿意足, 漠不關心, 憂心忡忡) and the 不忍 "cannot bear to" construction (忍無可忍, 慘不忍睹). The last group is about urgency and shock (刻不容緩, 迫在眉睫, 駭人聽聞).

frames.en: heart and mind together
然 makes an adverb: 'suddenly, all at once'
忍 'bear, endure'
'not in time' / 'does not allow'

origin.text: 叔夜俊俠，故興高而采烈
origin.text_s: 叔夜俊侠，故兴高而采烈

items.note: Liu Xie was describing the poet Xi Kang's style, "lofty in feeling, fierce in colour". Only later did it come to mean "cheerful".

ex.h: 當桂英興高采烈的找尋降龍木時，赫然發現它不翼而飛了！
ex.py: Dāng Guìyīng xìng gāo cǎi liè de zhǎo xún xiáng lóng mù shí, hè rán fā xiàn tā bù yì ér fēi le!
ex.src: wikipedia: 穆桂英掛帥 (2012年電視劇)
ex.en: When Guiying went happily to look for the Dragon-Taming Wood, she found to her shock that it had vanished!
ex.h_t: 當桂英興高采烈的找尋降龍木時，赫然發現它不翼而飛了！
ex.h_s: 当桂英兴高采烈的找寻降龙木时，赫然发现它不翼而飞了！

items.note: The German word Schadenfreude is usually translated with this 成語.

ex.h: “幸灾乐祸”一词只在德语中有。
ex.py: “Xìng zāi lè huò” yī cí zhǐ zài Déyǔ zhōng yǒu.
ex.en: Only German has a single word for 'Schadenfreude'.
ex.h_t: “幸災樂禍”一詞只在德語中有。
ex.h_s: “幸灾乐祸”一词只在德语中有。

items.en: unable to make up one's mind

ex.h: 对于是否要去医院探望Mary,Tom有点犹豫不决。
ex.py: Duì yú shì fǒu yào qù yī yuàn tàn wàng Mary, Tom yǒu diǎn yóu yù bù jué.
ex.en: Tom couldn't quite decide whether to visit Mary in hospital.
ex.h_t: 對於是否要去醫院探望Mary,Tom有點猶豫不決。
ex.h_s: 对于是否要去医院探望Mary,Tom有点犹豫不决。

ex.h: 短短数天之后，珍珠港事变爆发，美方才恍然大悟。
ex.py: Duǎn duǎn shù tiān zhī hòu, Zhēnzhūgǎng shì biàn bào fā, měi fāng cái huǎng rán dà wù.
ex.en: Only a few days later Pearl Harbor was attacked, and the Americans suddenly understood.
ex.h_t: 短短數天之後，珍珠港事變爆發，美方才恍然大悟。
ex.h_s: 短短数天之后，珍珠港事变爆发，美方才恍然大悟。

ex.h: 她對她丈夫的死漠不關心。
ex.py: Tā duì tā zhàng fū de sǐ mò bù guān xīn.
ex.en: She was indifferent to her husband's death.
ex.h_t: 她對她丈夫的死漠不關心。
ex.h_s: 她对她丈夫的死漠不关心。

items.note: 忡忡 "troubled", a reduplicated adjective typical of the 詩經.

ex.h: 我想变富，不再因钱忧心忡忡。
ex.py: Wǒ xiǎng biàn fù, bù zài yīn qián yōu xīn chōng chōng.
ex.en: I want to get rich and stop worrying about money.
ex.h_t: 我想變富，不再因錢憂心忡忡。
ex.h_s: 我想变富，不再因钱忧心忡忡。

items.note: The source has 忍不可忍, "endure the unendurable", which is the opposite advice.

ex.h: 忍无可忍，弱小者也会反抗。
ex.py: Rěn wú kě rěn, ruò xiǎo zhě yě huì fǎn kàng.
ex.en: Pushed too far, even the weak will fight back.
ex.h_t: 忍無可忍，弱小者也會反抗。
ex.h_s: 忍无可忍，弱小者也会反抗。

ex.h: 總統不由自主地笑了起來。
ex.py: Zǒng tǒng bù yóu zì zhǔ de xiào le qǐ lái.
ex.en: The president couldn't help laughing.
ex.h_t: 總統不由自主地笑了起來。
ex.h_s: 总统不由自主地笑了起来。

items.en: to feel as if it happened to oneself

ex.h: 艾莉絲看見邁爾斯追了出去後被瑪姬拒絕，心裡感同身受。
ex.py: Àilìsī kàn jiàn Mài'ěrsī zhuī le chū qù hòu bèi Mǎjī jù jué, xīn lǐ gǎn tóng shēn shòu.
ex.en: Alice saw Miles run after Maggie and get turned down, and felt it as if it were her own pain.
ex.h_t: 艾莉絲看見邁爾斯追了出去後被瑪姬拒絕，心裡感同身受。
ex.h_s: 艾莉丝看见迈尔斯追了出去后被玛姬拒绝，心里感同身受。

ex.h: 而项飞田是个忘恩负义的小人，后来反而拼命追查马走日的下落。
ex.py: Ér Xiàng Fēitián shì gè wàng ēn fù yì de xiǎo rén, hòu lái fǎn ér pīn mìng zhuī chá Mǎ Zǒurì de xià luò.
ex.en: Xiang Feitian, an ungrateful scoundrel, later did all he could to track Ma Zouri down.
ex.h_t: 而項飛田是個忘恩負義的小人，後來反而拼命追查馬走日的下落。
ex.h_s: 而项飞田是个忘恩负义的小人，后来反而拼命追查马走日的下落。

ex.h: 之後，衛斯理接到通知，古九非慘死在檳城家中，屍體慘不忍睹。
ex.py: Zhī hòu, Wèisīlǐ jiē dào tōng zhī, Gǔ Jiǔfēi cǎn sǐ zài Bīnchéng jiā zhōng, shī tǐ cǎn bù rěn dǔ.
ex.en: Later Wesley was told that Gu Jiufei had died a terrible death at his home in Penang; the body was too horrible to look at.
ex.h_t: 之後，衛斯理接到通知，古九非慘死在檳城家中，屍體慘不忍睹。
ex.h_s: 之后，卫斯理接到通知，古九非惨死在槟城家中，尸体惨不忍睹。

ex.h: 当代小品通过中央电视台春节联欢晚会的近20年的推广，取得了很大的进步，成为观众喜闻乐见的一个艺术形式。
ex.py: Dāng dài xiǎo pǐn tōng guò Zhōngyāng Diànshìtái Chūnjié Liánhuān Wǎnhuì de jìn 20 nián de tuī guǎng, qǔ dé le hěn dà de jìn bù, chéng wéi guān zhòng xǐ wén lè jiàn de yī gè yì shù xíng shì.
ex.en: Promoted for nearly twenty years by CCTV's Spring Festival Gala, the modern comic sketch has made great progress and become an art form audiences love.
ex.h_t: 當代小品通過中央電視臺春節聯歡晚會的近20年的推廣，取得了很大的進步，成為觀眾喜聞樂見的一個藝術形式。
ex.h_s: 当代小品通过中央电视台春节联欢晚会的近20年的推广，取得了很大的进步，成为观众喜闻乐见的一个艺术形式。

origin.text: 歲亦無恙耶？民亦無恙耶？王亦無恙耶？
origin.text_s: 岁亦无恙耶？民亦无恙耶？王亦无恙耶？

items.note: The Queen Dowager of Zhao asks the envoy of Qi, in this order, whether the harvest, the people and the king are well. Then she explains why the king comes last.

ex.h: 商人看見貝兒能夠安然無恙地回來不斷的擁抱著她不放。
ex.py: Shāng rén kàn jiàn Bèi'ér néng gòu ān rán wú yàng de huí lái bù duàn de yōng bào zhe tā bù fàng.
ex.en: When the merchant saw Belle come back safe and sound, he hugged her and wouldn't let go.
ex.h_t: 商人看見貝兒能夠安然無恙地回來不斷的擁抱著她不放。
ex.h_s: 商人看见贝儿能够安然无恙地回来不断的拥抱著她不放。

ex.h: 入侵的日軍被打得措手不及，將领来岛通总也被击毙。
ex.py: Rù qīn de Rì jūn bèi dǎ de cuò shǒu bù jí, jiàng lǐng Láidǎo Tōngzǒng yě bèi jī bì.
ex.en: The invading Japanese were caught off guard, and their commander Kurushima Michifusa was killed.
ex.h_t: 入侵的日軍被打得措手不及，將領來島通總也被擊斃。
ex.h_s: 入侵的日军被打得措手不及，将领来岛通总也被击毙。

items.note: 刻 was a unit of time (a hundredth of a day).

ex.h: 楊大郎明白母親苦衷，但父親有難刻不容緩，故向母親許下諾言，必會帶領老父和眾弟平安回家。
ex.py: Yáng Dàláng míng bái mǔ qīn kǔ zhōng, dàn fù qīn yǒu nán kè bù róng huǎn, gù xiàng mǔ qīn xǔ xià nuò yán, bì huì dài lǐng lǎo fù hé zhòng dì píng ān huí jiā.
ex.en: Yang the eldest understood his mother's concerns, but his father was in danger and there was no time to lose, so he promised her he would bring his father and brothers home safe.
ex.h_t: 楊大郎明白母親苦衷，但父親有難刻不容緩，故向母親許下諾言，必會帶領老父和眾弟平安回家。
ex.h_s: 杨大郎明白母亲苦衷，但父亲有难刻不容缓，故向母亲许下诺言，必会带领老父和众弟平安回家。

ex.h: 再加上馆舍三次火灾的发生，让新馆的建设迫在眉睫。
ex.py: Zài jiā shàng guǎn shě sān cì huǒ zāi de fā shēng, ràng xīn guǎn de jiàn shè pò zài méi jié.
ex.en: On top of that, the building caught fire three times, which made a new library extremely urgent.
ex.h_t: 再加上館舍三次火災的發生，讓新館的建設迫在眉睫。
ex.h_s: 再加上馆舍三次火灾的发生，让新馆的建设迫在眉睫。

ex.h: 僵尸审判作为中世纪教廷最为骇人听闻的片段之一而载入史册。
ex.py: Jiāng shī shěn pàn zuò wéi zhōng shì jì jiào tíng zuì wéi hài rén tīng wén de piàn duàn zhī yī ér zǎi rù shǐ cè.
ex.en: The Cadaver Synod went down in history as one of the most appalling episodes of the medieval papacy.
ex.h_t: 殭屍審判作為中世紀教廷最為駭人聽聞的片段之一而載入史冊。
ex.h_s: 僵尸审判作为中世纪教廷最为骇人听闻的片段之一而载入史册。

items.note: 諱 "to avoid (a name)": the names of rulers and parents were taboo, 諱.

ex.h: 公众终于对关于空气污染的意见直言不讳了。
ex.py: Gōng zhòng zhōng yú duì guān yú kōng qì wū rǎn de yì jiàn zhí yán bù huì le.
ex.en: The public has finally spoken out frankly about air pollution.
ex.h_t: 公眾終於對關於空氣汙染的意見直言不諱了。
ex.h_s: 公众终于对关于空气污染的意见直言不讳了。

ex.h: 樂觀而有野心，不太在意細節，決定目標便會勇往直前。
ex.py: Lè guān ér yǒu yě xīn, bù tài zài yì xì jié, jué dìng mù biāo biàn huì yǒng wǎng zhí qián.
ex.en: Optimistic and ambitious, not much bothered by details, they forge ahead once they've set a goal.
ex.h_t: 樂觀而有野心，不太在意細節，決定目標便會勇往直前。
ex.h_s: 乐观而有野心，不太在意细节，决定目标便会勇往直前。

lessons.title: 典故
lessons.intro: Every 成語 here has a story or a precise source behind it: a seller of spears and shields (自相矛盾), a poet at the river where Xiang Yu died (捲土重來), two princes splitting the road to Luoyang (分道揚鑣). You can use them without knowing the story, but the story is what makes them stick. 自相矛盾 is taught in full, from the 韓非子 text, in the main course.

items.note: A man of Chu praised his shield (nothing can pierce it) and his spear (it pierces anything). "What if your spear strikes your shield?" He had no answer.

ex.h: 你在自相矛盾。
ex.py: Nǐ zài zì xiāng máo dùn.
ex.en: You're contradicting yourself.
ex.h_t: 你在自相矛盾。
ex.h_s: 你在自相矛盾。

origin.text: 江東子弟多才俊，卷土重來未可知
origin.text_s: 江东子弟多才俊，卷土重来未可知

items.note: Du Mu at the place where Xiang Yu killed himself rather than retreat. The young men east of the river were talented; he might have come back. The source writes 卷 for 捲.

ex.h: 随着一战的结束，列强卷土重来，中国经济迅速转向萧条。
ex.py: Suí zhe Yī Zhàn de jié shù, liè qiáng juǎn tǔ chóng lái, Zhōngguó jīng jì xùn sù zhuǎn xiàng xiāo tiáo.
ex.en: When the First World War ended, the great powers came back, and China's economy quickly fell into depression.
ex.h_t: 隨著一戰的結束，列強捲土重來，中國經濟迅速轉向蕭條。
ex.h_s: 随着一战的结束，列强卷土重来，中国经济迅速转向萧条。

origin.text: 先即制人，後則為人所制
origin.text_s: 先即制人，后则为人所制

ex.h: 田令孜认为杨师立会反对自己和陈敬瑄，决定先发制人。
ex.py: Tián Lìngzī rèn wéi Yáng Shīlì huì fǎn duì zì jǐ hé Chén Jìngxuān, jué dìng xiān fā zhì rén.
ex.en: Tian Lingzi thought Yang Shili would turn against him and Chen Jingxuan, and decided to strike first.
ex.h_t: 田令孜認為楊師立會反對自己和陳敬瑄，決定先發制人。
ex.h_s: 田令孜认为杨师立会反对自己和陈敬瑄，决定先发制人。

origin.text: 洛陽我之豐沛，自應分路揚鑣
origin.text_s: 洛阳我之丰沛，自应分路扬镳

items.note: Two officials quarrelled over which of them should give way in the streets of Luoyang. The emperor ruled that from then on they should take separate roads. 鑣 is the bit of a horse.

ex.h: 罗明远把白求恩交给了护送部队，两人就此分道扬镳了。
ex.py: Luó Míngyuǎn bǎ Báiqiú'ēn jiāo gěi le hù sòng bù duì, liǎng rén jiù cǐ fēn dào yáng biāo le.
ex.en: Luo Mingyuan handed Bethune over to the escort, and there the two parted ways.
ex.h_t: 羅明遠把白求恩交給了護送部隊，兩人就此分道揚鑣了。
ex.h_s: 罗明远把白求恩交给了护送部队，两人就此分道扬镳了。

ex.h: 張惠妹因為張雨生的協助，從默默無名成為家喻戶曉的歌手。
ex.py: Zhāng Huìmèi yīn wèi Zhāng Yǔshēng de xié zhù, cóng mò mò wú míng chéng wéi jiā yù hù xiǎo de gē shǒu.
ex.en: With Tom Chang's help, A-mei went from unknown to a household name.
ex.h_t: 張惠妹因為張雨生的協助，從默默無名成為家喻戶曉的歌手。
ex.h_s: 张惠妹因为张雨生的协助，从默默无名成为家喻户晓的歌手。

items.en: tit for tat, in direct opposition

origin.text: 夫一切問答，如針鋒相投
origin.text_s: 夫一切问答，如针锋相投

items.note: Zen at first. A good question-and-answer meets "like needle point to needle point", in perfect agreement. Now it means the reverse, direct confrontation.

ex.h: 言談之間時常與長歌針鋒相對，但實際上相當疼惜她。
ex.py: Yán tán zhī jiān shí cháng yǔ Chánggē zhēn fēng xiāng duì, dàn shí jì shàng xiàng dāng téng xī tā.
ex.en: When they talk, he is always at odds with Chang'ge, but in fact he cares for her a great deal.
ex.h_t: 言談之間時常與長歌針鋒相對，但實際上相當疼惜她。
ex.h_s: 言谈之间时常与长歌针锋相对，但实际上相当疼惜她。

origin.text: 皆白裳、白旂、素甲、白羽之矰，望之如荼
origin.text_s: 皆白裳、白旗、素甲、白羽之矰，望之如荼

items.note: King Fuchai of Wu's army, one square all in white "like 荼 (reed flowers)", one all in red "like fire". It was a show of strength.

ex.h: 戰爭如火如荼。
ex.py: Zhàn zhēng rú huǒ rú tú.
ex.en: The war is raging.
ex.h_t: 戰爭如火如荼。
ex.h_s: 战争如火如荼。

origin.text: 軒然大波起，宇宙隘而妨
origin.text_s: 轩然大波起，宇宙隘而妨

ex.h: 琅威理返回英国后，宣传他在华受辱的经历，引起轩然大波。
ex.py: Láng Wēilǐ fǎn huí Yīngguó hòu, xuān chuán tā zài Huá shòu rǔ de jīng lì, yǐn qǐ xuān rán dà bō.
ex.en: Back in Britain, Lang publicised the humiliations he had suffered in China, causing an uproar.
ex.h_t: 琅威理返回英國後，宣傳他在華受辱的經歷，引起軒然大波。
ex.h_s: 琅威理返回英国后，宣传他在华受辱的经历，引起轩然大波。

items.en: a walking corpse, a living dead

origin.text: 不學者雖存，謂之行尸走肉耳
origin.text_s: 不学者虽存，谓之行尸走肉耳

items.note: First said of people who don't study. 尸 is the old form of 屍.

ex.h: 他已形同行屍走肉。
ex.py: Tā yǐ xíng tóng xíng shī zǒu ròu.
ex.en: He's become a walking corpse.
ex.h_t: 他已形同行屍走肉。
ex.h_s: 他已形同行尸走肉。

items.en: to make something up out of nothing

origin.text: 天下萬物生於有，有生於無
origin.text_s: 天下万物生于有，有生于无

items.note: In 老子, being comes from non-being. Now it means a fabrication, the opposite of a compliment.

ex.h: 这完全是无中生有的东西。
ex.py: Zhè wán quán shì wú zhōng shēng yǒu de dōng xī.
ex.en: This is a complete fabrication.
ex.h_t: 這完全是無中生有的東西。
ex.h_s: 这完全是无中生有的东西。

ex.h: 這種敵對的稱呼和態度，在《朝鮮王朝實錄》中比比皆是。
ex.py: Zhè zhǒng dí duì de chēng hū hé tài dù, zài «Cháoxiǎn Wángcháo Shílù» zhōng bǐ bǐ jiē shì.
ex.en: Such hostile names and attitudes are everywhere in the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty.
ex.h_t: 這種敵對的稱呼和態度，在《朝鮮王朝實錄》中比比皆是。
ex.h_s: 这种敌对的称呼和态度，在《朝鲜王朝实录》中比比皆是。

items.en: to live in peace and work happily

ex.h: 王延彬治理泉州期間，官员和民众安居乐业，粮食连年丰收。
ex.py: Wáng Yánbīn zhì lǐ Quánzhōu qī jiān, guān yuán hé mín zhòng ān jū lè yè, liáng shí lián nián fēng shōu.
ex.en: While Wang Yanbin governed Quanzhou, officials and people lived in peace, with good harvests year after year.
ex.h_t: 王延彬治理泉州期間，官員和民眾安居樂業，糧食連年豐收。
ex.h_s: 王延彬治理泉州期间，官员和民众安居乐业，粮食连年丰收。

origin.text: 建久安之勢，成長治之業
origin.text_s: 建久安之势，成长治之业

ex.h: 在上者要施行的政务能办到，在下者能胜任交办的公务，因此国家才能长治久安。
ex.py: Zài shàng zhě yào shī xíng de zhèng wù néng bàn dào, zài xià zhě néng shèng rèn jiāo bàn de gōng wù, yīn cǐ guó jiā cái néng cháng zhì jiǔ ān.
ex.en: Only when those above can carry out their policies, and those below can do the work given them, does a state enjoy lasting peace.

lessons.title: 描寫
lessons.intro: 成語 for describing: where something comes from (來龍去脈), how it is told (輕描淡寫, 淋漓盡致, 直截了當), what is there (應有盡有, 貨真價實), how stable it is (搖搖欲墜, 不堪一擊), how far apart two things are (大相徑庭). Several started in a specialised field: geomancy (來龍去脈), painting and drama (輕描淡寫), Zen (裝模作樣), and a novel (百花齊放, from 鏡花緣).
